cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(host_font_probe C)

# Proves that the fonts generated by tools/gen_font.py can actually be used by
# the LVGL present here: it asks for real glyphs and fails if they come back
# empty. See main.c for why this deserves its own test.
#
#   cmake -S test_apps/host_font_probe -B build/host_font_probe -G Ninja
#   cmake --build build/host_font_probe
#   ./build/host_font_probe/host_font_probe

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)

get_filename_component(REPO_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(LVGL_DIR "${REPO_ROOT}/examples/k26_k9_demo/managed_components/lvgl__lvgl")

if(NOT EXISTS "${LVGL_DIR}/lvgl.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "LVGL not found at ${LVGL_DIR}; build examples/k26_k9_demo once")
endif()

set(FONT_20 "${REPO_ROOT}/generated/lv_font_ime_20.c")
set(FONT_16 "${REPO_ROOT}/generated/lv_font_ime_16.c")
foreach(_f "${FONT_20}" "${FONT_16}")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${_f}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "${_f} missing; run: python tools/gen_font.py")
    endif()
endforeach()

file(GLOB_RECURSE LVGL_SRCS "${LVGL_DIR}/src/*.c")
list(FILTER LVGL_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/libs/")
list(FILTER LVGL_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/drivers/")
list(FILTER LVGL_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/others/")
list(FILTER LVGL_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/draw/espressif/")
list(FILTER LVGL_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/draw/nema_gfx/")
list(FILTER LVGL_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/draw/opengles/")
list(FILTER LVGL_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/draw/vg_lite/")
list(FILTER LVGL_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/draw/sdl/")
list(FILTER LVGL_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/draw/nanovg/")

add_library(lvgl_probe STATIC ${LVGL_SRCS})
target_include_directories(lvgl_probe PUBLIC
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}"          # lv_conf.h for the probe
    "${LVGL_DIR}"
    "${LVGL_DIR}/src"
)
target_compile_definitions(lvgl_probe PUBLIC LV_CONF_INCLUDE_SIMPLE)
target_compile_options(lvgl_probe PRIVATE -w)

add_executable(host_font_probe main.c ${FONT_20} ${FONT_16})
target_link_libraries(host_font_probe PRIVATE lvgl_probe)
target_compile_options(host_font_probe PRIVATE -w)
